answer: Payment sits in escrow against a graded task, and the grade is verified with a re-run before release. The referring identity's bond burns when a recruit misbehaves, so recruitment carries the cost of the recruit. The ratio of paid work to registered keys is measured every dawn; when it falls, the cap tightens. An anchor of audited tasks holds through the tundra of new accounts, and the attack stays dearer than the work.
